## Cellebrite Appoints Shiven Ramji Chief Executive Officer, Succeeding Thomas E. Hogan
...
TYSONS CORNER, Va. and PETAH TIKVA, Israel, Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cellebrite DI Ltd. (NASDAQ: CLBT), a global leader in AI-powered Digital Investigative and Intelligence solutions for the public and private sectors, today announced that Shiven Ramji, who joined Cellebrite as President, Products and Technology in May 2026, has succeeded Thomas E. Hogan as the Company's CEO as part of a planned transition, effective immediately. In addition, Ramji will be appointed to the Company's Board of Directors. Hogan joined Cellebrite as Executive Chairman in August 2023, became interim CEO in January 2025 and was subsequently appointed CEO in August 2025.

August 13, 2026 | Shiven (Shiv) Ramji, Cellebrite CEO 

Today, Cellebrite’s Board of Directors announced that I have been appointed Chief Executive Officer. 

It is an incredible honor to lead this company. 

I joined Cellebrite only a few months ago, but in that time I have spent countless hours with our people, our customers and our technology. And one thing became clear to me very quickly: the work we do matters. 

Every day, investigators, forensic examiners, intelligence professionals and public safety leaders around the world take on extraordinarily difficult work. They search for missing children. They investigate violent crimes. They defend nations. They protect businesses. They help bring truth to light and ensure justice can move forward. 

Our job at Cellebrite is to help them do that work better, faster and with greater confidence. 

That mission is what brought me here. And as CEO, it will remain at the center of everything we do.

## FAQ

 What leadership change did Cellebrite (CLBT) disclose in August 2026? 

 Cellebrite replaced its CEO effective August 13, 2026, as part of a planned succession, with Thomas E. Hogan stepping down and Shiven Ramji being appointed Chief Executive Officer on the same date. 

 When did Thomas E. Hogan step down as Cellebrite (CLBT) CEO? 

 Thomas E. Hogan ceased serving as CEO of Cellebrite effective August 13, 2026, pursuant to a mutual agreement between him and the company, and he also resigned from the board on that date. 

 Who is the new Chief Executive Officer of Cellebrite (CLBT)? 

 Cellebrite appointed Shiven Ramji as Chief Executive Officer effective August 13, 2026. His appointment was described as part of a planned succession, coinciding with Thomas E. Hogan’s departure from the CEO role. 

 Did Thomas E. Hogan remain involved with Cellebrite (CLBT) after resigning? 

 Yes. After ceasing to serve as CEO and resigning from the board on August 13, 2026, Thomas E. Hogan agreed to act as an advisor to Cellebrite for a six-month period. 

 Does the Cellebrite (CLBT) CEO change affect its existing SEC registrations? 

 The company stated that the information is incorporated by reference into its existing Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements, so those registrations now reflect this leadership transition.
